name: SikaFuko® Eco-1
tagline: PVC Re-injectable Hose For Sealing Construction Joints
summary: SikaFuko® Eco-1 is a re-injectable hose for sealing various construction joints in watertight concrete structures. To seal the joint, SikaFuko® Eco-1 is injected with suitable Sika® Injection materials, such as acrylate and cement suspensions (for multiple injections) or polyurethane resins (for single injection).
metaDescription: SikaFuko® Eco-1 is a re-injectable hose for sealing various construction joints in watertight concrete structures. To seal the joint, SikaFuko® Eco-1 is injected with suitable Sika® Injection materials, such as acrylate and cement suspensions (for multiple injections) or polyurethane resins (for single injection).
attributes: Multiple re-injections with Sika injection acrylate resins or microfine cement suspensions
One time injectable with Sika injection polyurethane injection resins
Ideal back-up solution for combination with waterstops
Tested in water pressures up to 10 bar (100m)
Suitable for many different structures and construction methods
usage: Suitable for many different structures and construction methods where additional joint security/safety is required

Prevents water ingress through concrete joints in the following typical structures: Water retaining or excluding structures, water reservoirs, dams, canals, sewage treatment plants, tunnels, subways, retaining walls
As a back-up system for waterbars

items.label: Composition
items.text:
White inner core | PVC
Red outer layer | Foamed plastic

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
SikaFuko® Eco-1
A | Injection channel
B | White perforated PVC spiral hose core to support the concrete pressure
C | Foamed plastic outer layer as a sealing membrane and to prevent cement paste penetration during concreting
D | Staggered slot perforations in the foamed plastic outer layer for the uniform discharge of injection resins

items.label: Shore A hardness
items.text:
White inner core | D 50 +/- 3
Red outer layer | A 80 +/- 5 (not expanded)

items.label: Tensile strength
items.text:
White inner core | ≥ 10 N/mm2
Red outer layer | ≥ 10 N/mm2 (not expanded)

items.label: Elongation
items.text:
White inner core | ≥ 100 %
Red outer layer | > 50 %

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Concrete surface must be clean and all loose materials removed before installing hose and placing concrete.

rel.t: Polyacrylic elastic injection resin for permanent watertight sealing
rel.s: Sika® Injection-306 is a very low viscous, elastic polyacrylic injection resin with a versatile and adjustable reaction time which can be used in ground water protection zones.
a: Provides a passivating environment for embedded steel reinforcement
Adjustable curing time between 10 and 60 minutes
Permanently elastic, can absorb limited movement
Capable of reversibly absorbing (swelling) and releasing (shrinking) moisture
Very low viscosity comparable to water
